## Answer sheet (open only after answering)

### 1. `CIVIO-GF2K04-CLR-FILE-POSITION-0027`: key (D) Andres P. De Vera

- Why correct: "Andres P. De Vera" is filed first. In filing order the indexed units are: DEVERA / ANDRES / P; DIMACULANGAN / GLORIA / S; ESGUERRA / NORA / C; VERGARA / MARIO / L. A surname prefix (de, dela, del, delos, san, van, Mc, O') joins the rest of the surname as one unit, spelled as written (ARMA Rule 6). This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 6), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.
- (A) "Gloria S. Dimaculangan" is the answer only if you split the surname prefix off and filed the name under the rest of the surname. Indexed correctly it is DIMACULANGAN / GLORIA / S, which files second.
- (B) "Mario L. Vergara" indexes as VERGARA / MARIO / L and files last, not first.
- (C) "Nora C. Esguerra" indexes as ESGUERRA / NORA / C and files third, not first.
- Source: Civio Filing Rules v2 / ARMA Rule 6 (ANSI/ARMA 12-2005) <https://webstore.ansi.org/standards/arma/ansiarma122005>
- File: `docs/research/gap-fill-2000-04.json`
